# Skip link

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use a skip link as the first focusable control so keyboard users can bypass repeated navigation and move to main content.

## When to use

- Include on every page with repeated header or navigation content.
- Target the unique main-content landmark ID.

## When not to use

- Do not omit it because the page appears short at one viewport size.
- Do not point it at an element that is missing, hidden or earlier in the focus order.

## Anatomy

- **Skip anchor (required):** A govuk-skip-link with a fragment href appears at the start of body content.
- **Target landmark (required):** The fragment resolves to the main element's unique ID.
- **Module hook (required):** data-module=govuk-skip-link enables supported target-focus handling.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `a` | `govuk-skip-link` | The first focusable element in the GOV.UK page template. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- Initialise GOV.UK Frontend so the module can manage focus on targets that are not naturally focusable.
- The anchor and fragment still provide useful navigation without JavaScript.
- Do not intercept activation or replace fragment navigation with scrolling alone.

## Accessibility contract

- Keep the link first in the useful keyboard order and visibly expose it on focus.
- Use a stable target such as main#main-content and verify focus moves there in supported browsers.
- Localise the link text for the page language.

## Content rules

- Use “Skip to main content” unless the target has a clearer established localised label.
- Do not add several skip links unless the page structure and user testing demonstrate a need.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.color.focus-text`
- `govuk.color.link`

## HTML examples

### Main-content skip link

```html
<a href="#main-content" class="govuk-skip-link" data-module="govuk-skip-link">Skip to main content</a>
```
